confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Mumbai prices; no live listings or price pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderately reliable. Beer uses bottled domestic beer as a proxy because draught is uncommon. Cocktail and wine are derived from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.2x beer, wine glass about 2x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. Hotel and hostel anchors vary most by district, star rating and season, and July monsoon can soften leisure demand. Assumes roughly 88 to 92 rupees per USD. FX is the 2026-03-20 RBA figure from a search snapshot of the RBA exchange-rates page, not a current-day observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single named comparable city. Basis is general Indian metropolitan price levels, adjusted upward for Mumbai's higher hotel and restaurant prices. Drinks are derived from the beer anchor.
